## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] `mypy` passes
- [ ] `pytest` passes (new behaviour has tests)
- [ ] Docs updated if the public API changed (`docs/`, docstrings)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No private data, paths, secrets or large binaries added

## Notes

Anything reviewers should pay particular attention to (e.g. a new calibrator's
guarantees, numerical behaviour, or backward-compatibility of the saved format).
